title.zh: 在日常安排里怎样辨认
title.en: Recognize the pattern in everyday arrangements

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的一次约定是周五前确认周末安排。你周四发现做不到，于是说明目前能确定什么、哪部分仍需等待，并提出新的确认时间。提前告知和重新提出约定值得分别观察；提出新时间还不等于对方已接受，也不等于已经履行。这里回看自己的行为，不能替对方评价可信度，更不能从四题均分判定一个人是否值得交往。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented agreement is to confirm weekend plans by Friday. On Thursday you realise this is unlikely, explain what is known and pending, and propose a new confirmation time. Early notice and a revised proposal are separate actions; proposing a time means neither acceptance nor fulfilment. Review your actions without rating the other person’s trustworthiness or deciding from four items whether someone is worth dating.

title.zh: 只选一件低风险的小约定

paragraphs.zh: 可以在私人草稿列出“原来答应什么”“现在确实能做什么”“需要重新询问什么”。试写：“我原定在……前确认，现在只能确定……；你是否愿意考虑……？”不发送也能完成练习；保留对方拒绝新提议的空间，不把解释当成取消责任。
paragraphs.en: Privately list the original promise, what is now feasible and what needs asking again. Draft: “I planned to confirm by …; I can currently confirm …; would you consider …?” Sending is optional. Leave room to decline the revision without using an explanation to erase responsibility.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是可选择的原创练习，不是伴侣评选或关系安全检查。八组各四题，按最近四周自己的频率作答，完整数值回答才显示各组独立均分；不适用或无法判断可选NA，不补低分。可以只读八份指南、保留私人草稿，或分享公开指南而不分享答案和经历。分数不能抵消控制、威胁或伤害，也不要求你发起不安全的谈话。
paragraphs.en: These optional original exercises select no ideal partner and check no relationship safety. Each of eight groups needs four numeric ratings about your own actions over the past four weeks for a separate mean. NA is available when inapplicable or uncertain, without low-score filling. Read all eight guides, keep a private draft or share a public guide without answers or experiences. Scores offset no control, threats or harm and require no unsafe conversation.

title.zh: 商量与施压可能只差一步

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的伴侣说周六想独自安排时间。你可以确认是否影响已有共同约定，再决定自己的安排，而不要求查看聊天、定位或用即时回复证明关心。尊重独处与完成共同事务可以同时讨论；“我不喜欢这个安排”是自己的感受，不自动赋予否决对方社交的权利。本组描述自己的做法，不测关系安全性或对方是否忠诚。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional partner wants Saturday for their own plans. Check whether an existing shared commitment is affected, then make your plans without requiring messages, location access or instant replies as proof of care. Personal time and shared responsibilities can both be discussed. Disliking an arrangement grants no automatic veto over someone’s social life. This describes your actions, without assessing relationship safety or a partner’s fidelity.

title.zh: 练习提出一个可拒绝的邀请
title.en: Make one invitation that can genuinely be declined

paragraphs.zh: 可用虚构安排分别写“共同约定”“我的偏好”“对方仍可自行决定的事”。一句讨论稿可以是：“共同安排需要改吗？其余时间你可以自己决定。”不需要真的获取隐私或试探对方，也不必把不喜欢写成同意或控制。
paragraphs.en: For invented plans, separate a shared agreement, your preference and the other person’s choices. A draft might ask whether the shared plan changes while leaving their remaining time to them. Obtain no private information or test of loyalty; dislike need imply neither agreement nor control.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是可选择的原创练习，不是伴侣评选或关系安全检查。八组各四题，按最近四周自己的频率作答，完整数值回答才显示各组独立均分；不适用或无法判断可选NA，不补低分。可以只读八份指南、保留私人草稿，或分享公开指南而不分享答案和经历。分数不能抵消控制、威胁或伤害，也不要求你发起不安全的谈话。

title.zh: 同一件事可能需要不同回应
title.en: The same event can call for different responses

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构对话中，对方说“今天有点累”。你先问是想有人听、一起想办法，还是暂时独处。这个询问为纠正猜测留下空间；对方说暂时不聊时，继续追问不必然更体贴。及时回应、回应方式与对方的实际体验是三件事，四题频率不能证明你已准确照顾需求，也不能决定谁更爱谁。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, someone says they are tired. Ask whether they want listening, ideas or time alone. The question makes a guess correctable; more questions need not be more caring if they prefer no conversation now. Response timing, response form and the other person’s experience are separate. Four frequency items establish neither accurately met needs nor who loves whom more.

paragraphs.zh: 可在纸上写同一句回应的三个版本：倾听、提供一项可拒绝的帮助、允许稍后再谈。再标出每版要先询问的条件。只是草稿即可，不向真人发送测试消息，不把没被采纳的帮助视为对方不领情。
paragraphs.en: Draft three replies: listening, one optional offer and room to talk later. Mark what each would need to ask first. A private draft is enough, without testing a real person or treating declined help as ingratitude.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是可选择的原创练习，不是伴侣评选或关系安全检查。八组各四题，按最近四周自己的频率作答，完整数值回答才显示各组独立均分；不适用或无法判断可选NA，不补低分。可以只读八份指南、保留私人草稿，或分享公开指南而不分享答案和经历。分数不能抵消控制、威胁或伤害，也不要求你发起不安全的谈话。

title.zh: 请求、猜测与命令的区别
title.en: Distinguish a request, a guess and a demand

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的一天里，你希望有人陪你整理一件烦心事。把“你应该懂”改成“今晚你有十分钟听我说吗？不用替我解决”，让请求的时间与方式更明确；这仍是可拒绝的请求。对方不能满足不自动代表冷漠，你提出请求也不等于脆弱或依赖。这里回看自己表达需要的频率，不认证关系是否互惠。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, you want company while sorting through a concern. “Do you have ten minutes tonight to listen? You need not solve it” makes time and form clearer than “You should know.” It remains a request that can be declined. Unavailability does not automatically show indifference, and asking proves neither weakness nor dependence. Review the frequency of expressing needs without certifying reciprocity.

title.zh: 试一个小而清楚的请求

paragraphs.zh: 可写一份虚构请求，包含需要、时间、对方可选择的回应；另写“如果现在不方便，我可考虑什么其他安排”。不需要披露真实困扰，也不把备用安排写成惩罚或必须独自承担一切。
paragraphs.en: Draft an invented request with the need, timing and room to choose a response. Add another arrangement to consider if now is unsuitable. Disclose no real concern and make the alternative neither punishment nor a demand to manage everything alone.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是可选择的原创练习，不是伴侣评选或关系安全检查。八组各四题，按最近四周自己的频率作答，完整数值回答才显示各组独立均分；不适用或无法判断可选NA，不补低分。可以只读八份指南、保留私人草稿，或分享公开指南而不分享答案和经历。分数不能抵消控制、威胁或伤害，也不要求你发起不安全的谈话。

title.zh: 偏好、隐私与暗示要分开

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的聚餐提议让你不太想参加。说“这次我更想安静休息”比先答应、再期待对方猜到不情愿更清楚；表达偏好仍不同于否定对方的邀请。诚实不要求交出全部私人信息，也不允许用“我只是直说”替贬低开脱。本组关注自己的偏好表达，不评定道德高低或判定谁在说谎。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a proposed meal does not appeal to you. Saying you would prefer quiet rest makes the preference clearer than accepting while expecting reluctance to be guessed. Expressing a preference differs from rejecting the person. Honesty requires no complete disclosure and excuses no belittling as bluntness. This concerns your expression of preferences, without moral ranking or identifying liars.

title.zh: 只把一个小选择说清楚

paragraphs.zh: 可把虚构邀请的回应拆成“感谢或确认邀请”“我愿意或不愿意的部分”“可选替代”。允许没有替代方案，也不编造借口来完成练习。只练一句准确、不过度暴露隐私的话，不靠争执证明坦率。
paragraphs.en: For an invented invitation, draft acknowledgement, what you want or decline and an optional alternative. An alternative need not exist; invent no excuse for the exercise. Practise one accurate sentence with limited disclosure, without creating conflict to prove candour.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是可选择的原创练习，不是伴侣评选或关系安全检查。八组各四题，按最近四周自己的频率作答，完整数值回答才显示各组独立均分；不适用或无法判断可选NA，不补低分。可以只读八份指南、保留私人草稿，或分享公开指南而不分享答案和经历。分数不能抵消控制、威胁或伤害，也不要求你发起不安全的谈话。

title.zh: 同一件小事，意义可能不同
title.en: One event may mean different things to each person

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构对话里，两人都以为自己被打断。你可以复述“你刚才还没讲完，我却接着说了”，再问是否准确。确认对方的经历，不等于接受对方对全部动机的判断，也不取消自己补充不同经历的权利。理解和同意可以分开；本组自报频率不能证明读心、同理心能力或对方一定感觉被理解。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, both people feel interrupted. Summarise that the other had not finished when you began, then ask whether that is accurate. Acknowledging an experience accepts no complete account of motives and removes no right to add your perspective. Understanding can differ from agreement. Self-reported frequency proves neither mind-reading nor empathy ability, nor that the other person felt understood.

title.zh: 做一次可以被纠正的复述
title.en: Offer one summary that can be corrected

paragraphs.zh: 可给虚构原话写“对方明确说的内容”“我的推测”“可请其纠正的复述”。试写：“我理解你在意的是……，有哪些地方不对？”不要求真人重新讲述不愿谈的经历，也不把复述当成必须获得谅解的交换。
paragraphs.en: For invented words, separate what was stated, your inference and a correctable summary. Draft: “I understand the concern as …; what have I missed?” Ask no real person to repeat unwanted experiences and trade no summary for required forgiveness.

paragraphs.zh: 以上是可选择的原创练习，不是伴侣评选或关系安全检查。八组各四题，按最近四周自己的频率作答，完整数值回答才显示各组独立均分；不适用或无法判断可选NA，不补低分。可以只读八份指南、保留私人草稿，或分享公开指南而不分享答案和经历。分数不能抵消控制、威胁或伤害，也不要求你发起不安全的谈话。

title.zh: 让具体安排替代默认规则
title.en: Replace an assumed rule with a specific arrangement

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的两人对“忙完联系”理解不同，一个指当天，另一个指下一次休息。把含糊期待改成能询问的时间范围，并说明暂时无法承诺的部分，更便于发现差异。一次谈妥不代表永久同意，协商也不要求把每项分歧折中。本组关注自己的协商做法，不提供配对指数、关系结局或谁的需求更合理的裁决。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, “contact you when free” means today to one person and the next break to another. Ask about a time range and name what cannot be promised. This makes a difference discussable, without turning one agreement into permanent consent or requiring every difference to meet halfway. The group concerns your negotiating actions, without compatibility scores, predicted outcomes or a ruling on whose need is more reasonable.

title.zh: 把一个期待拆成可讨论的小安排
title.en: Turn one expectation into a discussable arrangement

paragraphs.zh: 可为虚构约定写“具体事项”“双方仍需确认的条件”“何时可以重新讨论”。试写：“你说的及时大约指什么时候？我能做到的是……，这是否可接受？”允许答案是不行或暂时不知道，不用这份结果逼对方降低边界。
paragraphs.en: For an invented agreement, name the action, conditions still to confirm and when it could be revisited. Ask what “soon” means and whether what you can offer is acceptable. Allow no or uncertainty, without using this result to push a boundary down.

title.zh: 暂停可以保护谈话，也可能被用来施压
title.en: A pause can protect a discussion or become pressure

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构的一次争论中，你用讽刺打断了话题。回到“刚才那句话具体是什么、可能造成什么影响、我准备怎样调整”，比只说“别生气了”更便于讨论责任。提出修复不保证被接受，也不要求立即恢复亲密；对方可以暂停。这里回看自己的谈话行为，不证明问题已解决，亦不能把反复伤害改称沟通风格。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, sarcasm interrupts an argument. Naming the remark, its possible impact and the adjustment you propose makes responsibility more discussable than asking someone to stop being upset. A repair offer guarantees no acceptance or immediate closeness; the other person can pause. Review your conversational actions without claiming resolution or renaming repeated harm as a communication style.

title.zh: 只练习一个具体而可拒绝的下一步
title.en: Practice one specific next step that can be declined

paragraphs.zh: 可在私人草稿写“我做了什么”“哪些影响还需听对方说明”“我可负责的一项后续行动”。不附加“但都是因为你”，也不设定对方必须原谅的时间。草稿无需发送；若不适合对话，可以停止，不靠完成练习证明关系安全。
paragraphs.en: Privately draft your action, impacts still needing the other person’s account and one follow-up you can own. Attach neither blame nor a deadline for forgiveness. Sending is optional; stop if a conversation is unsuitable, without treating completion as proof of safety.
